improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon, the Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/images/gideon-og-preview.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: Search engines and social platforms use meta descriptions and OG tags to generate previews. A clear, benefit-driven description improves click-through rates from Google results, while properly formatted OG tags ensure professional previews when links are shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook. Including the free trial offer and entry price creates urgency and transparency without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name while clearly stating what it does (AI trade and business assistant). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and reduces friction by highlighting the free trial with no commitment. This builds trust and encourages visitors to engage before hitting the paywall.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: After your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose monthly or annual billing, with annual plans saving you 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—users wondering what happens when their trial ends. It transparently explains the paywall, immediately reframes it with value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and anchors on the low daily price to reduce sticker shock. Mentioning the annual savings creates an upsell path.
